about: Colt Single Action Army (1873 pattern), #693 step 1: experiments/gun_lab/saa/saa_blender.py. Godot space, metres, the gun's local frame (barrel along -Z, up +Y, right +X). Angles in degrees about the axis given (right-hand rule). Travel numbers marked 'est' are estimates from the mechanism's geometry, not measured.

rounds.show: loaded: case+bullet; spent: case only; empty: neither

Cylinder.note: chamber k sits at 60k deg clockwise from the top seen from behind; +60 about the axis turns the next chamber up under the hammer (Colt's way, clockwise from behind). Turned by the hand while cocking from half to full cock.

Hammer.note: est: the four clicks (C-O-L-T); full cock leaves the nose 0.45 in behind the shield

Trigger.note: est: the trigger comes back with the hammer as it cocks, a short pull lets it go

Bolt.note: est: down while the cylinder turns, up into the next notch at full cock

Gate.note: est: swings out and down to the right about an axis along the bore

Ejector.note: slides back (toward +Z) by the stroke; its rear tip then stands past the cylinder's back
